sources.evidence: Board setup connects PA5 at CN7 pin 10 and PA6 at CN9 pin 1.

sources.revision: MB1404 H563ZI C-01, schematic pack v2.0 (2025-01-27); sheet 6/9 is titled Connectors
sources.evidence: ST schematic-pack index and extracted PDF text identify the exact MB1404 H563ZI C-01 drawing and connector sheet. The connector footprint artwork has not been visually aligned to the supplied sprite anchors.

sources.revision: UM3115 Rev 3 (09-Apr-2025), STM32H5 Nucleo-144 board MB1404
sources.evidence: Tables 21/23 list CN7 pin 10 = D13/SPI_A_SCK/PA5 and CN9 pin 1 = A0/PA6; Table 25 lists the same nets on morpho CN12 pins 11/13. Table 28 records that Rev 2 corrected CN7 pin 10 from PA15 to PA5, so Rev 1 must not be used. Section 11.1 / Table 17: LD1 is on PB0 by default (SB43 ON, SB51 OFF); PA5 has no LED load on a stock board.

sources.revision: UM3115 Rev 3, Figure 6 (p.11, 70.00 x 133.34 mm outline and top photo) and Figure 17 (p.32)
sources.evidence: Contact centres measured on the embedded Fig. 6 photo (810x1619 px, 11.54 x 11.57 px/mm; 2.54 mm morpho pitch reproduced to 0.01 px/mm; 1.6% radial correction for the 8.5 mm female housings): CN7 pin 1 at (56.60, 32.51) mm, CN9 pin 1 at (10.57, 64.61) mm, +/-0.5 mm. Silkscreen '1' marks pin 1 top-left; D13/SCK silkscreen beside CN7 right column row 5 and A0 beside CN9 left column row 1 confirm the numbering. Generated by scripts/gen-h563-board.py. CN8 and CN10 were measured on the same photo with the same calibration on 2026-10-24: CN8 pin 1 at (10.57, 41.91) mm and CN10 pin 1 at (56.60, 59.69) mm; their columns agree with CN9 and CN7 within 0.1 mm, and the silkscreen (NC/IOREF/NRST/3V3/5V/GND/GND/VIN on CN8, AVDD/AGND/GND on CN10) confirms pin 1 top-left.

review.note: Every Zio (CN7-CN10) and morpho (CN11/CN12) contact mapped from UM3115 Rev 3 Tables 21-25, generated by scripts/gen-h563-board.py. Contacts that need a non-default solder bridge (Table 17), SWD/clock pins and unmodelled nets (NC, VIN, NRST, BOOT0, VBAT, VREFP, 5V_EXT, 5V_STLK) stay visual-only; on-board loads are listed per contact. Contact centres are on the measured 2.54 mm grid from Fig. 6 (+/-0.5 mm); a CAD-exact check against the MB1404 schematic remains open.
